request.spec:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no
patrons.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no
patrons.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Patrons and backing are in, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**What a user sees:** each person's row has a new Patrons column showing:
- **Patrons:** their names, sorted and separated by a comma and space.
- **Backing:** the patrons' due-totals added up, skipping any that are n/a. It shows 0.00 when there are no patrons.
- **A picker and an "Add patron" button** for adding one patron at a time.

The picker leaves out the person themselves and anyone already named as their patron. The server also refuses those cases, and anyone not on the sheet, with a 400 that writes nothing. That refusal appears as an error on the row (`person-patron-error`). The test's own refused attempts are caught by the picker, so this error shows only if the server refuses a choice the screen still offered, e.g. a stale screen after another user's change.

**Storage and server:**
- **Storage:** a new `patron` table (migration `V19__patron.sql`) records who named whom, by id. A renamed person therefore shows their new name everywhere they are a patron.
- **Endpoint:** a new `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/people/{personId}/patrons` stores a patron and writes `PATRON_ADDED sheet=<id> by=<user> name=<name> patron=<patron name>` to the audit file.
- **People list:** each person now includes their patrons' ids (`patronIds`), so the front end can show names and work out backing.

Backing is calculated on the front end, the same way as the existing due-total column. A patron's held or overdue claims therefore count exactly as they do in that patron's own due-total.

The front-end column is in `features/patrons/patrons.slot.tsx`.
